questions.question:
Which of the given figures when placed in the 5th position would continue the series that is established by the first four figures?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1e71c6003cba7331ac9c655bce96399844ba33268d955bf50873c3f5ec834842.png]
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic:

Step I: The 'Images' are shifting to each next sides in the each next boxes.

Step II: The 'Shaded Triangle' is getting shaded in the next blank triangle in clockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e5980cf032a7ffd12ecf143afabb81cc17b1b8f39189142b8483a1ad840f691a.png] 

So, option 3 will be the 5th image in the given series.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
